programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Game Done Changed: When Bart discovers a profitable glitch in an online game, he ropes Principal Skinner into his criminal enterprise. Marge and Maggie discover paradise. (S34, ep 10)

programme.title: Pride Rules

programme.title: Hawaii Five-0

programme.title: S.W.A.T.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Pin Gal: A mysterious figure from Marge's past returns to coach her for a bowling tournament. (S34, ep 17)

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Step Brother from the Same Planet: Homer is stunned by his feelings of rage and resentment when Grampa becomes a doting stepfather. Lisa and Bart throw a slumber party. (S34, ep 8)

programme.title: The Office (US)
programme.desc: Fundraiser: Andy tries to confront Robert at a silent charity auction, while Oscar bonds with Angela's husband, Senator Robert Lipton. (S8, ep 22)

programme.title: The Office (US)
programme.desc: Turf War: Dwight and Jim fight a nearby branch for a big client, Andy makes a plan to get his old job back and Pam learns more about Nellie. (S8, ep 23)

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Fan-Ily Feud: Homer publicly disparages a pop singer and faces the wrath of her vengeful fans. (S34, ep 18)

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Write Off This Episode: Marge is seduced by the money and prestige of Big Charity fundraising when she and Lisa launch a charity together. (S34, ep 19)
